See the messages still waiting to reach a terminal or agent.

wdx agent send and wdx terminal send keep a message until its holder says it typed it. When a holder dies, its messages go on if the agent resumes the same conversation. If it starts anew, or a shell does, they are held for you to send or discard, as what they were meant for is gone.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`wdx message discard`](#wdx-message-discard) | Discard a message still waiting |
| [`wdx message list`](#wdx-message-list) | List a project's messages still waiting, oldest first |
| [`wdx message resend`](#wdx-message-resend) | Send a message still waiting to its terminal or agent, as it is now |

## wdx message discard

Discard a message still waiting.

```sh
wdx message discard --id <id> [flags]
```

A review's comments go back to being drafts, to send again.

### Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--id <id>` |  | id of the message |

- `--id` is required

### Examples

```sh
# Discard a held message
wdx message discard --id msg-1a2b3c4d
```

### Output

That it went. With `--json`: {"result": "removed"}

With `--json`, `result` is one of: `removed`.

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`daemon_unavailable`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#daemon_unavailable) | 3 | the daemon is not running or not answering |
| [`not_found`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#not_found) | 1 | nothing has this name or id |
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |

## wdx message list

List a project's messages still waiting, oldest first.

```sh
wdx message list [--project-id <id> | --project-name <name>] [flags]
```

Without a project flag, the project the working directory is in.

### Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project-id <id>` |  | id of the project (default: the one the working directory is in) |
| `--project-name <name>` |  | name of the project (default: the one the working directory is in) |

- at most one of `--project-id` or `--project-name`

### Examples

```sh
# The messages of the project you are in
wdx message list

# Another project's, as JSON
wdx message list --project-name app --json
```

### Output

The messages, oldest first. With `--json`: {"messages": [...]}

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`daemon_unavailable`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#daemon_unavailable) | 3 | the daemon is not running or not answering |
| [`invalid_path`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#invalid_path) | 1 | the path cannot be used |
| [`not_found`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#not_found) | 1 | nothing has this name or id |
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |

## wdx message resend

Send a message still waiting to its terminal or agent, as it is now.

```sh
wdx message resend --id <id> [flags]
```

It goes in whatever conversation the agent is in now.

### Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--id <id>` |  | id of the message |

- `--id` is required

### Examples

```sh
# Send a held message
wdx message resend --id msg-1a2b3c4d
```

### Output

The message. With `--json`: {"result": "queued", "message": {...}}

With `--json`, `result` is one of: `queued`.

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`agent_not_running`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#agent_not_running) | 1 | the agent's AI coding agent is not running |
| [`daemon_unavailable`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#daemon_unavailable) | 3 | the daemon is not running or not answering |
| [`not_found`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#not_found) | 1 | nothing has this name or id |
| [`send_failed`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#send_failed) | 3 | the message did not reach the terminal's holder |
| [`terminal_not_running`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#terminal_not_running) | 1 | the terminal's shell is not running |
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |
